pages.title: Spring Harvest
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r II$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Hoes$(br2)§lEffect: §r Right-click to till a 3×3 or 5×5 area with one click; can also harvest all mature crops with one click and replant them in place, with harvests going straight into the inventory.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
